# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — ODQ-001F Baseline-Relative Repair Direction

Date: `2026-09-01`

Status: **Disposition B approved in principle subject to the exact repair in
this direction; final ODQ-001F approval is not yet recorded**

`r0.8` supersession note: the original “fallback” shorthand below is preserved
as historical owner direction but is no longer the active role taxonomy.
`historical_scientific_control`, `historical_compatibility_candidate`, and
`authorized_operational_fallback` are separate; the last is unavailable in
Stage A.

## Owner Direction

The scientific owner approves the staged, profile- and domain-aware empirical
qualification architecture in principle, but rejects any interpretation that
the program seeks one uniquely correct, optimal, or universally best FRUIT
algorithm.

FRUIT has genuine tradeoffs among angular-scale response, flux recovery,
morphology, noise amplification, atmospheric and other nuisance leakage,
convergence, robustness, and computational cost. Different exact method
identities may occupy different scientifically useful points in that trade
space. Relative value may depend on signal profile and observing conditions.

The v0.1 scientific objective is therefore **baseline-relative qualification**.
Exact historical Citlali FRUIT is the paired control and scientific-performance
goalpost. A candidate may qualify over a prospectively defined applicability
domain when it demonstrates material, reproducible, statistically credible
improvement over that control in one or more prioritized scientific dimensions
while satisfying approved non-inferiority or safety guardrails in every
protected dimension.

## Required Repair

The ODQ-001F frame shall:

1. deny that the empirical program must find one global optimum;
2. admit as legitimate outcomes one broadly adequate method, one recurrence
   with conditional policies, multiple specialized methods, restricted-domain
   qualification, or no qualifying replacement;
3. define paired candidate-minus-historical comparisons with a metric-specific
   sign convention while retaining absolute metrics for scientific meaning and
   common-mode failure detection;
4. replace informal “better under most conditions” language with prospective
   applicability-population, condition-distribution/weighting, signal-profile,
   aggregate, uncertainty, lower-tail, outcome-fraction, stratification,
   failure, and catastrophic-regression requirements;
5. preserve the approved protected-non-inferiority plus prioritized-material-
   improvement rule without requiring dominance of every metric;
6. recognize a Pareto trade space and permit multiple exact qualification
   identities when specialization is scientifically material;
7. prefer the simplest broadly adequate production policy and retain multiple
   methods only when evidence establishes meaningful specialization rather
   than small benchmark fluctuations;
8. freeze populations, strata, criteria, margins, thresholds, and guardrails
   before opening the untouched qualification population; and
9. retain exact historical Citlali as the fallback throughout the program and
   outside any narrower candidate qualification domain.

## Repaired Decision Language To Return

> Approve a staged, profile- and domain-aware empirical qualification program
> whose purpose is to identify demonstrable improvements over historical
> Citlali, not to claim a uniquely optimal FRUIT algorithm. Qualification may
> yield a universal method, conditional policies, multiple specialized
> methods, restricted-domain improvements, or no replacement method.

This language is the candidate final ODQ-001F decision. The owner requested its
repair and re-presentation before approval is recorded; therefore the decision
ledger remains open until the owner explicitly accepts the repaired record.

## Non-Effects

This direction does **not**:

- authorize the empirical-development lane or alter the governing program
  lifecycle;
- approve an applicability population, condition weighting, profile, metric,
  estimator, uncertainty rule, margin, threshold, stratum, catastrophic limit,
  recurrence, method, parameter/adaptation policy, or stopping rule;
- establish absolute perfect recovery as an acceptance standard;
- guarantee that historical Citlali is scientifically correct or numerically
  available through every refactored candidate route;
- authorize prototype implementation, experimental execution, qualification,
  recurrence selection, Stage B authorship, production change, or Unity work;
  or
- displace the exact historical method inside or outside any domain.

Those remaining choices and the empirical-lane launch gate are stated in the
repaired
[`ODQ_001F_PROFILE_QUALIFIED_EMPIRICAL_DEVELOPMENT_FRAME.md`](ODQ_001F_PROFILE_QUALIFIED_EMPIRICAL_DEVELOPMENT_FRAME.md).
